rows.grounds: of-both; genitive dual of ubhaya (gender contextually masculine, referring to both families/lineages)
family+destruction; nominative singular masculine compound, destruction of the family/lineage (kula)
would-be; third person singular active optative of √as (to be)
poor; nominative singular masculine of daridra (surface daridro, sandhi form of daridraḥ)
birth+after+birth; locative singular neuter in iterative/reduplicative compound expressing repetition, i.e. in every birth/birth after birth
